baseline.budget: production costs.estimate + Ledger.select, .04 cumulative per family diagnostic batch; free external reuse charged normally per arm, exact repeated request within batch charged once
baseline.diagnostic_judge: unchanged shared-operations Sonnet5.5 output1024 report .8; matches candidate-first cached packet contract
baseline.ordering: Production CampaignStore.order: lane, priority, least-used query, similarity, key; diagnostic starts zero query counts. Detector baseline top3 union balanced top20 stays fixed across arms.
baseline.retrieval: BenchBackground.decode/index full-corpus IDF; fixed union default top3 cross-file floor .5/.3 plus balanced same-file top20 floor .35. Raw ties score/sourceID/documentposition.

EXPERIMENT.json.clarification_before_first_evaluation: Historical normal estimated ledger censors at first funded missing exact answer. Native reserve/settle results separate. Synthetic diagnostic batches have fixed outcome-independent charges and tri-state unknown report observations; no historical claim.
controls: retrieval union identical across ordering arms
prompts/thresholds/model/output cap/cache identity unchanged within each cohort
source SHA and pinned Git proof
size and cost quartiles; explicit expensive positive displacement

fixed_features.grid: single frozen weight vector; cost exponents0 and1 (feature-only ablation and cost-aware)
fixed_features.independent_owners: 1 iff (file, owner or module) differs; syntactic proxy not a semantic independence claim
fixed_features.learned_ranker: none: inspected partial labels and small family sample do not justify fitting
fixed_features.operation: Jaccard of distinct syntactic call/attr-call names longer than2 excluding fixed generic calls; tokens from frozen background; fallback regex call names for captured historical candidates

EXPERIMENT.json.historical: Read production-discovery frozen manifests first; all13 captured configured histories with exact Haiku shared-operations output2048 report .5. Native scheduler .04 cumulative actual-usage settlement/max-output reservation supplementary to all-arm normal-estimate ledger comparison. Original retrieval union immutable and no historical IDF reconstruction from snippets. Exact missing answers stop native arm at first reserved question.
EXPERIMENT.json.hypothesis: A fixed interpretable utility per canonical estimated judge dollar can improve useful funded operation coverage with retrieval held fixed; it may instead displace valuable expensive baseline pairs.
EXPERIMENT.json.novel_sampling: Up to8 exposed funded missing novel exact pairs from naive/protected arms and up to4 current-funded controls, excluding exact previously reviewed pairs only. Stable hash sample, matched repository and size bucket when available. Full unchanged Candidate dump and separate blind score-free source packet. Native missing frontier only, no speculative suffix.
EXPERIMENT.json.promotion_gate: No promotion by worker. Require more independently useful emitted reports, zero lost established useful baseline reports, no increase in negatives/disputes, and fresh family-separated confirmation before coordinator proposal. Missing answers or retrieval-only gains cannot pass.
EXPERIMENT.json.protection: At each diagnostic batch fund the current-order affordable set first, then cost-rank remainder using same cap; an intentionally strict funding-preservation control. Historical native scheduler comparison keeps configured reservation/pacing and baseline lane first in protected arm; naive reorder changes order only, leaving admission rules unchanged. Measure later baseline losses rather than promise future preservation.
EXPERIMENT.json.scope: immutable coordinator background scope; no inferred adoption from defaults; no background recapture or union of revisions
EXPERIMENT.json.split: DEVELOPMENT/REGRESSION ONLY. All scaled coordinator labels observed already. Connected endpoint/family components grouped before scoring; stable SHA256 family lineage assigns dev-A/dev-B. No training or parameter selection across either split; no fresh holdout claim. Historical PR remains one lineage across all revisions.
EXPERIMENT.json.stop: One bounded run plus correctness fixes, then contrasting repo once; no retuning. Stop live requests after up to12 funded unknowns, central physical allowance1 USD; worker makes zero calls.

funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.controls: Previously unseen source pairs funded by current arm; tag baseline-only losses and common-funded controls privately. Match repository and original under40/40plus size stratum and use a distinct query lineage where possible. Controls are source-unknown, not assumed negatives.
funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.evaluation: Same full-corpus IDF, pinned backgrounds and ranks reused. Compare funded/emitted useful reports, source-confirmed new operations, lost useful prior reports, separate/related/disputed, cost/size/same-file strata, runtime. Candidate count alone is not benefit. All gold panels DEVELOPMENT/REGRESSION.
funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.judging: Existing central paired Jev context+Claude shared-operations contracts, unchanged wording/output. Claude is the mechanism policy; Jev is separately funded independent diagnostic assessment, not a second charge attributed to the original synthetic .04 ledger. Root-only providers.
funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.mechanism: Frozen original current/fixed_feature/naive_cost/protected_cost on the identical cached public retrieval candidate union. Fixed utility .60 original similarity+.30 call-name operation evidence+.10 distinct syntactic owners; cost variants unchanged. No judge, gold ID or future history runtime feature.
funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.round1_split: Existing development dev-A family/lineage batches only. Exclude every exact pinned source pair already reviewed in shared index-v2 and every previously observed exact rendered paired request. No new holdout claim.
funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.round2_reserve: Existing dev-B query-lineage batches held out from new round1 judging; no shared exact pairs/endpoints to be falsely called disjoint operation families. Before round2 freeze, root-reconciled source families must be disjoint or new pinned-repo query families selected with original full-corpus baseline.
funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.selection: All eligible actually funded dev-A pairs, differential gains/lost-current first, then matched current-funded/common controls; stable hash/lineage round robin. No verdict/confidence/score threshold sampling. Freeze chunks32 pairs and separate canonical request chunks32 requests.

spend.historical_older_spend: Separate exact ledger; current-phase credit only when root accepts unique request attribution. Duplicate archived-failure repeat excluded by default.

funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.stop_and_iteration: No promotion/closure from tiny pilot or cached labels. Root evaluates after actual .20 and independent source review. If no useful benefit, preregister one error-justified revised mechanism before round2; judge another >=.20 on disjoint novel source families. Do not retune thresholds/prompts or reuse round1 evaluation labels as runtime features.
funded-rounds/round1/EXPERIMENT.json.user_override: At least .20 actual new paid judging, cache/repeats excluded; no closure until minimum or root-verified eligible exhaustion. Round2 if no useful benefit with one justified revision and disjoint novel lineages.

funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.baseline: Frozen historical current and original fixed arms in continuation-v57; do not rerun them.
funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.evaluation: Compare complete paired PR reports against frozen current; source-confirmed gains/lost priors, false/related/disputed, repeated revision families once, size/same-file and cost, elapsed/memory. Censored suffix unknown.
funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.hypothesis: Flat global fixed utility discards original baseline priority and per-query round robin, allowing one changed function to consume exploration call slots. Restore original admission scaffolding while using the same fixed utility to select peers; preserve useful broad-query coverage without a source-label runtime oracle.
funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.novel_questions: Only actual native-reserved first missing exact requests, excluding every already-asked key and known paid failure. Preserve old failure and valid-new-answer receipts. Controls from existing reviewed old exact cases are cached, count0newspend.

one_variant.baseline_lane: Exact original CampaignStore.order baseline subsequence unchanged.
one_variant.canonical_cost: Original native reservation/settle/pacing/perPR cumulative .04. No cheapest-function scoring and no extra cheap-tail expansion.
one_variant.exploration: Original priority, then original per-(lane,new.qualname) attempted-count fairness, then unchanged fixed_feature utility. Update counts as each pending candidate is placed, exactly as original scheduler does.
one_variant.fixed_utility: .60 original similarity + .30 existing syntactic operation/call evidence + .10 distinct syntactic owner
one_variant.tie: descending utility, existing sourceID, native source line/document position, new sourceID, candidate key

funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.round2_condition: Root assesses original direction after minimum spend/source review or verifies eligible historical supply exhaustion. Historical new-arm run is development/regression; it is not a disjoint-family holdout. Novel public dev-B families remain reserved for a paid round2 if required.
funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.runtime_guards: Original captures/settings/source pins, chronological isolated new-arm ledger, canonical prompt/model/output, source filters/thresholds and max calls unchanged. No normal or old native arm rerun.
funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.split: All real PRs are inspected development/regression. Public new judging: dev-A round1, dev-B reserved. No claim historical errors and historical rerun are disjoint families.
funded-rounds/round2/EXPERIMENT.json.stop: All compatible new-arm histories complete or only source/known-paid-failure boundaries remain or root512/$1 historical cap. No invented requests for quota. Root decides further public dev-B paid source-family evaluation.

funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.controls: Novel to source review; current-only losses and common-funded controls, never assumed negative. Matched source/cost strata privately where possible.
funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.disjointness: Exclude every exact reviewed source pair in shared index-v2; exclude every source endpoint present in R1 public queue; require frozen dev-B lineage IDs disjoint from R1 dev-A lineage IDs. Root semantic family reconciliation remains necessary before claiming novel operation-family independence.
funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.error_basis: Private historical source-reviewed RP01/RP02 lost under flat feature ordering at native call/duplicate-attempt cap. Historical revised arm completes12/12 with0eligible new questions; it does not spend toward round2 minimum.
funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.gold_reuse: Existing original400+scaled gold ranks/floors and all prior public comparisons preserved. No retrieval/index/embedding fit or representation change. Development/regression, not fresh gold holdout.
funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.judging: Unchanged central Jev context+Claude shared-operations Sonnet5.5/output1024. Sonnet arm admission is synthetic .04, Jev is separate physical diagnostic judging; neither is an actual PR claim.
funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.one_revised_mechanism: Same original fixed utility; restore original baseline ordering, priorities and per-query round robin before fixed-feature peer ordering. No extra ranker/threshold/prompt variant.
funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.scope: Public explanatory round2; separate from real-PR regression replay and actual PR funding.
funded-rounds/round2/PUBLIC-EXPERIMENT.j.selection: Use cached exact dev-B candidate unions and full-corpus original IDF/ranks. Compute only new fair_fixed_feature funding with original Sonnet normal-estimate Ledger .04 per synthetic family batch. Reuse old current funding as independent controls.
